query_text: Are there any academic fields that don't have enough people trying to teach?

messages.content: Are there any academic fields that don't have enough people trying to teach?

message.content:
Yes. **Teacher education and teaching-related fields are not universally short on people**, but shortages are common in *specific* areas like **special education, English as a Second Language, math, and science**. NCTQ says schools are “always looking” for teachers in those subjects, while **elementary education and social studies** are described as more competitive because they are popular certification areas.[2]

At the college level, there also appears to be a shortage of people entering **teacher-preparation programs** specifically. Higher Ed Dive reports that many colleges are struggling to produce enough teacher candidates, with education majors declining at some institutions and only a small share of freshmen saying they plan to become teachers.[1]

If you meant **other academic fields besides education**, the results here only directly support teacher shortages in K–12 and postsecondary teaching generally, not a complete ranking of all academic disciplines.[1][2][5]
